instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: mascot platformers were gaming's best era.

Spyro, Crash and Banjo ruled the late 90s. Mascot platformers had more personality than most heroes today. Crash Bandicoot 4 proved in 2020 that the old formula still works. Super Mario Odyssey sold over 28 million copies. Players clearly want these games. Agree?
